{"results":[{"name":"listJiraIssueChangelogs","description":"Get a Jira issue's field-change history — field edits only — paginated oldest-first with no ordering options. For the current value or most recent change, read total (which counts entries, not items) and request startAt = max(0, total - your page size); for counts or patterns across the history, page from startAt 0. A field's original value is in the first item that changed it; fields never changed leave no trace, and the log starts at the first edit, not at creation. On an item, from/to are IDs or raw values and are absent on text and array fields; fromString/toString are display text, and on array fields like labels each side is the complete set (space-joined, sorted) — diff the two sides, never read one as a delta. Jira omits from and fromString together when the field had no previous value, and to and toString together when it was cleared (so an assignee item with no to/toString is an unassignment). Match items on field, not position: order within an entry varies. Do not infer automation from author.accountType — a script running under a person's token reads \"atlassian\".","product":"jira","executeTool":"executeRead","inputs":[{"name":"cloudId","type":"string","required":true,"description":"Cloud ID, site prefix (e.g. \"acme\"), or any Jira URL"},{"name":"issueIdOrKey","type":"string","required":true,"description":"Issue key (PROJ-123), numeric ID, or a Jira issue URL","repairHint":"Use a key like PROJ-123 or paste the full issue URL. Do not pass issue numbers without the project key."},{"name":"startAt","type":"number","required":false,"description":"Zero-based index of the first changelog entry to return (for pagination). Defaults to 0.","minimum":0,"maximum":2147483647,"integer":true},{"name":"maxResults","type":"number","required":false,"description":"Maximum changelog entries per page (1-50). Defaults to 20; larger pages risk exceeding the client's token limit and failing the call. Use maxResults=1 as a cheap probe to read total before jumping to the end of the history.","minimum":1,"maximum":50,"integer":true}],"views":["compact","evidence"]}],"primaryTools":[{"name":"listJiraIssueComments","description":"Get a paginated list of comments for a Jira issue. Use this instead of getJiraIssue when an issue has many comments — getJiraIssue embeds at most 20 and cannot page them. Page with startAt until isLast is true; total is the full comment count. Each comment reports any visibility restriction on it and, on JSM, whether it is internal (jsdPublic: false) — check both before quoting or summarising a comment. Comments are returned as a flat list: a non-null parentId means the comment is a reply, and parentId identifies its root/parent comment. Group comments by parentId to reconstruct threads. Set reactionDetail when emoji reaction data is needed. For the issue's own fields, use getJiraIssue.","product":"jira","availableAsPrimaryTool":true}],"searchableCount":120,"totalCatalogSize":327}
